trip: Before landing we caught a glimpse of the mighty Mississippi River winding its way through the landscape and the sprawling expanse of Lake Pontchartrain too.
sights: The trip would have been a bust if we did nt make it to the French Quarter's historic charm and the hauntingly beautiful cemeteries.
events: Mardi Gras is most famous but we made it to the New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival for some of the best music you'll ever hear.
people: We got a glimpse of Harry Connick Jr. and Emeril Lagasse—both New Orleans natives.
custom1: Traveling to New Orleans is always a treat. The city is bustling with excitement. The scenery, The people. The night life. Unbeatable!
custom2: If wining and dining and dancing, and did I mention dining is your thing. Get over there. We enjoyed it day and night. We have to go home to rest.
